notes.subject: וישאלום
notes.rationale: 'u ɲini ka bɔ u nɔ na' (borrowni/laaji) san 'demand' — kɔrɔlenbaga be tamasiyɛn furakɛ minnu la: KJV 'lent' versus 'asked'.

notes.subject: וינצלו
notes.rationale: natsal: 'ka tu' (plunder) walima 'ka bɔ u bolo' (deliver) — ninnu filanan dɔrɔn de kelen ma da.

notes.subject: fɛnw
notes.rationale: Bamanankan ka nafa da kunw na minnu de Hebrikan ma jira.

notes.subject: וישאלום / וינצלו
notes.rationale: sha'al ani natsal jɔyɔrɔ la — 'ka ɲini' ani 'ka tu' ni jɔcogo kelen ye, o t'a jira Bamanankan na.

translation: Yawe ye ⟨את⟩ jama ka ɲɛgɛn di Mitsrayim (Misira) mɔgɔw ka ɲɛ la, olu de y'u ɲini-ɲini ka bɔ u nɔ na, ani u y'u tu u ka fɛnw bɛɛ la ⟨את⟩ Mitsrayim.

tokens.gloss: u y'u ɲini-ɲini ka bɔ u nɔ na
